title: Metadata-only Policy (Active)
description: Fields with approved metadata-only status: slot/binding exists but no separate DOCX placeholder is needed because the value is already rendered by a compound parent field.

policy.description: A metadata-only field has a slot and binding but no DOCX placeholder. The field's value is rendered by a compound parent field. No DOCX change needed.
constraints: Compound rendering field must have a verified DOCX placeholder in the locked contract.
Slot and binding remain functional for programmatic access.
Must not add a visible placeholder for a metadata-only field.

auditSuppression.description: Suppress CONTRACT_SLOT_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER and BINDING_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER for metadata-only fields. These checks will remain as informational notes (ACCEPTED_METADATA_ONLY_FIELD), not remediation.
auditSuppression.condition: field exists in metadataOnlyPolicy AND renderedBy compound field has DOCX placeholder verified in locked contract

fields.renderedBy: compound agency header (parent + issuing agency lines)
fields.runtimeBehavior: Agency body name is inferred from the issuing agency context. Slot exists for programmatic access but no visible placeholder is needed.
fields.auditBehavior: Suppress SLOT_WITHOUT_PLACEHOLDER and BINDING_WITHOUT_PLACEHOLDER. Emit ACCEPTED_METADATA_ONLY_FIELD instead.
fields.reason: Source form only has parent [1] and issuing [2] agency. No third agency-body blank exists. Adding a visible placeholder would introduce noise.

fields.runtimeBehavior: Atomic issueDate is part of compound place-date line. Filling document.issueDate populates the date portion of the compound line.
fields.auditBehavior: Suppress SLOT_WITHOUT_PLACEHOLDER and BINDING_WITHOUT_PLACEHOLDER. Emit ACCEPTED_METADATA_ONLY_FIELD instead.
fields.reason: Issue date is already part of compound place-date line (document.issuePlaceDateLine). Adding atomic date separately would duplicate the date display.

fields.runtimeBehavior: Cited deposit decision rendered via decision.decisionLine2 which references document.fullDocumentCode2. Canonical document.fullDocumentCode is aliased to fullDocumentCode2.
fields.auditBehavior: NOTE: BM-052 document.fullDocumentCode is CONFLICT_PENDING (see field-alias-policy.json). Alias and metadata-only suppression are both held pending form-author decision on RAR-001/RAR-004.
fields.reason: Cited deposit decision already rendered via decision.decisionLine2. Adding atomic document.fullDocumentCode separately would duplicate the citation.
fields.conflictNote: See field-alias-policy.json CONFLICT_PENDING entry for BM-052

fields.renderedBy: static text (official form has no dynamic decision citation)
fields.runtimeBehavior: The decision line is a static description in the official form, not a dynamic numbered blank.
fields.auditBehavior: Suppress SLOT_WITHOUT_PLACEHOLDER and BINDING_WITHOUT_PLACEHOLDER. Emit ACCEPTED_METADATA_ONLY_FIELD instead.
fields.reason: Official text is a static description, not a visible numbered blank. Reviewer decided against introducing dynamic decision citation unless explicitly requested.

note: All entries suppress CONTRACT_SLOT_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER and BINDING_WITHOUT_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER. BM-052 document.fullDocumentCode suppression is deferred due to CONFLICT_PENDING status.
